newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen higher at open.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen higher at open.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to move higher at the open on Thursday in a follow-through to yesterday's 93-point rally in the Dow.
But bonds are flat to lower and the market needs to position itself for Friday's February employment report, so any rally on Wednesday is likely to be limited.
The long bond was down 1/32 to yield 6.83 percent after U.S. jobless claims for the week ending March 1 came in at a lower than forecast 310,000 compared to 316,000 in the previous week.
